operating_notes.text: Recommended final dividend of ₹2.75 per share amounting to ₹132 crore.
Order book reached ₹9,416 Cr as of 31st March 2026.
Signed MoU with Crisil Limited to offer data-driven infrastructure solutions.
Order book ₹9,450 Cr at 30 June 2026, of which ₹4,700 Cr is turnkey and ₹2,100 Cr is RITES Videsh (₹1,775 Cr rolling stock export, about ₹900 Cr Bangladesh coaches).
Turnkey earns 1.5-2% margins and was 30-33% of Q1FY27 revenue; 70% of fresh order inflows are on a competitive basis.
REMCL posted about ₹22 Cr profit in Q1FY27 and paid RITES about ₹10 Cr dividend at a 91% payout ratio.

timeline.summary: RITES reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹2,415 Cr and PAT of ₹454 Cr, with a record order book of ₹9,416 Cr and a final dividend recommendation of ₹2.75 per share.
RITES held its Q4FY26 and FY26 earnings conference call, highlighting a record order book of ₹9,416 Cr and export income of ~₹300 Cr.
On May 27, 2026, RITES signed an MoU with Crisil Limited to provide integrated, data-driven infrastructure solutions.

On its 5 August 2026 Q1FY27 call, RITES said its order book stood at ₹9,450 Cr against a ₹10,000 Cr target, with export revenue guided at ₹300 Cr+ for FY27 and the Bangladesh coach order completing in FY28.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for final dividend at the 52nd AGM

watchlist.response: Named three causes (competitive bids, travel costs, pay revision) and reiterated 20% EBITDA and 15% PAT red lines, holding 22% and 17% in Q1.
watchlist.text: Margins falling sequentially and YoY; whether the bottom is reached

watchlist.response: Said the mix has shifted to 50-50 turnkey versus consultancy and export, and turnkey will not exceed about 50% of the book.
watchlist.text: Consultancy order wins lagging turnkey in competitive bidding

watchlist.response: Guided 8-10%, not the 20% the analyst suggested.
